definitions.explanation: The quality of being round or having curved edges. Used for physical shapes.
A figurative sense describing a softened or gentler quality in personality, tone, or flavor.

examples.english: This stone has a rounded shape.

examples.japanese: ⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}たせた→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: I gave the design a rounded feel.

examples.japanese: ⟦{角|かど}→角：02195_kado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}って→削る：03922_kezuru⟧{丸|まる}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、やさしい⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: If you shave the corners to create roundness, it gives a softer impression.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: With age, his personality has mellowed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸|まる}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧だ。
examples.english: This wine has a mellow flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{丸|まる}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あって→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{聞|き}いていて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦{心地|ここち}よい→心地よい：12515_kokochiyoi⟧。
examples.english: There's a gentleness to the way he speaks, and it's pleasant to listen to.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from the adjective ⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧ with the suffix ～み, which turns adjectives into nouns expressing the quality (like ⟦{甘|あま}み→甘み：17244_amami⟧ from ⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧). Can describe both physical roundness and figurative softness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {丸|まる}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have roundness; to be mellow)
- {丸|まる}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{帯|お}びる→帯びる：12428_obiru⟧ (to take on a rounded shape)
- {丸|まる}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧ (to add roundness)
- ⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{丸|まる}み⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (one's personality mellows)
